units.source_text: 不用说，沙地上的昆虫体小、貌丑。

en.t: Needless to say, insects that live in sandy ground are small-bodied and ugly.

units.source_text: 但是，专业的标本采集家，对蝴蝶和蜻蜓之类倒是不屑一顾的。

en.t: But professional specimen collectors actually look down on things like butterflies and dragonflies.

units.source_text: 这些标本专家所瞄准的，不是漂漂亮亮地装饰丰富自己的标本箱，

en.t: What these specimen specialists are after is not to decorate and fill out their specimen cases beautifully,

units.source_text: 也并非出于对分类学的关心，

en.t: nor does it come from any concern for taxonomy,

units.source_text: 更不是为了寻找做中药的材料。

en.t: and still less is it for the purpose of finding materials for Chinese medicine.

units.source_text: 采集昆虫标本，还有更朴素、更直接的乐趣。

en.t: Collecting insect specimens has a plainer and more direct pleasure.

units.source_text: 那就是所谓“发现新种类”的乐趣。

en.t: It is the pleasure of what is called discovering a new species.
As long as you discover something,

units.source_text: 那你自己的名字也就能和昆虫长长的拉丁学名放在一起，

en.t: your own name can then be placed together with the insect's long Latin scientific name,

units.source_text: 用斜体字写进昆虫大图鉴里去呢。

en.t: and written in italics into a great illustrated encyclopedia of insects.

units.source_text: 而且，恐怕还能半永久地保存下来。

en.t: Moreover, it may well be preserved almost permanently.

units.source_text: 但如果那虫能长长地留在人们记忆中的话，

en.t: if that insect can remain for a long time in people's memories,

units.source_text: 就会显出努力的效果来。

en.t: then the effect of one's efforts will show itself.
